description: List open ideas on Somebody Build This, a free public board where anyone posts something they wish existed and builders make it. Each idea has a ticket number, title, link, a one-sentence goal for a first weekend version, tags, and how many builds are in progress and shipped. Newest first. Ideas never lock: anyone can build any idea, even one someone else is building. Builders ship by pressing "Ship it" on the idea's page and pasting a link. Use get_brief for one idea's full text and suggested plan.

limit.description: How many ideas to return (default 20, at most 50).

tag.description: Only ideas with this tag, like "home" or "for-kids".

name: list_open_ideas
title: List open ideas
